slots.purpose: Hero: show the beauty of a bouquet built from flowers in season in Australia, setting up the month-by-month hub.
slots.shot_brief: Real, licensed photo of a bride holding a loose, garden-style bouquet made only of stems that are in season in Australia at the time of the shoot (for example late spring stems such as garden roses, peonies or sweet peas, only if the season is confirmed from the shoot date and an authoritative source). Soft natural daylight, outdoors, bouquet in sharp focus, face cropped or turned away is fine. No florist tags, ribbons with logos or vendor branding. Consenting bride. Never AI.

slots.purpose: Visual anchor for the month-by-month guide: show how the palette of available flowers shifts across the Australian seasons.
slots.shot_brief: Flower still life on a neutral linen or stone surface: small groups of stems arranged left to right by Australian season (spring, summer, autumn, winter), no people, no place, no text, labels or month names in the image. Every stem must be one the article sources as in season in Australia for that season; if unsourced, leave it out. Soft window light, overhead or three-quarter angle. Preferred: licensed photo. AI allowed only if Nic approves, and then captioned 'Illustrative image' with no month claim.
